en.bdb: The earning of an apostate is defective

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨ੍ਹੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)nhai cha(n)dh na dhisiee jag jot sabaiee|

en.bdb: The blind cannot see the moon though its light scatters all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਾ ਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਸਮਝਈ ਕਿਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bolaa raag na samajhiee kih ghaT na jaiee|

en.bdb: The music loses not its melody if a deaf cannot understand it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਣਗੁਣੈ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਮਹਿਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: vaas na aavai gunagunai paramal mahikaiee|

en.bdb: In spite of plenty of fragrance, the person without power of smell cannot enjoy the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੰਗੈ ਜੀਭ ਨਾ ਉਘੜੈ ਸਭਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gu(n)gai jeebh naa ughaRai sabh sabadh suhaiee|

en.bdb: The word resides in one and all, but the dumb cannot move his tongue (to pronounce it).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਕੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: satigur saagar sev kai nidh sabhanaa paiee|

en.bdb: The true Guru is an ocean and the true servants receive treasures out of it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਹਥਿ ਘਘੂਟਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit_en: bemukh hath ghaghooTiaa tis dhos kamaiee ||9||

en.bdb: The apostates get ',the shells only because their cultivation and labour is defective.
